name: steward
description: Steward is a role-based engineering team plugin: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes work into a task DAG with file ownership, and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents. Covers feature delivery (/steward), the bug track (/steward fix, B0-B3 triage with repro -> failing test -> root cause -> minimal fix -> regression), plan-only mode (/steward plan with an approval gate and clean-context plan critic), trusted-change gates (plan validation, independent verify reruns, baseline hash / out-of-bounds diff guard), the maintenance loop, takeover, and the evolution loop. The ZCode side also ships a full documentation pipeline for docTier=3: a seven-phase docs tree, the complete template library (PRD/FRD, contracts, page layout, test plan, deployment engineering), AGENTS/rules constraints, a naming guard and doc checks run locally. It also adds a lightweight first-principles clarification step with a 3-question P0 budget for M/L requests (S-level changes skip it) and a ZCode-only using-steward router skill that picks the right mode when the user is unsure.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Steward（长期维护型研发团队）：主代理作为 Tech Lead，把需求拆成任务 DAG，按依赖与文件所有权调度 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员与代码评审员。覆盖功能交付（/steward）、Bug 通道（/steward fix，B0–B3 分流：复现 → 失败测试 → 根因 → 最小修复 → 回归）与只出计划模式（/steward plan，批准门 + 干净上下文 Plan Critic），并自带可信变更门禁（计划校验、verify.mjs 独立复跑、基线 hash / 越界 diff 守卫）、维护循环、接手存量与演进循环。ZCode 侧另有 docTier=3 完整文档流水线：七阶段文档树、全量模板（PRD/FRD、契约、页面布局、测试方案、部署工程化）、AGENTS/rules 约束层、命名守卫与文档检查（全部本地脚本）；并新增 M/L 需求的第一性原理澄清与最多 3 个 P0 提问预算（S 级不追问），以及 `steward:using-steward` 技能路由（不知道用哪个入口/技能时先做路由）。
